milestones.title: Kernel attack surface mapping
milestones.note: 12+ CVEs assessed against 14.10 (all blocked/stubbed). 80+ dead ends documented. 34/76 device nodes inventoried, ioctl command space measured end to end (32M calls across 31 nodes, 48K calls full overcopy sweep). UMTX PI orphaned kernel waiter proven. AIO double-free closed (double-STATUS not double-free, 1500+ races). BSD-native range (1-530) exhausted. 17+ KASLR techniques tested, all dead. Lua loader kernel surface declared exhausted. WebKit is the only remaining path to kernel access.

milestones.title: WebKit / JSC attack vector
milestones.note: Second entry vector via browser engine. 20 HTML probes, 12+ findings documented. Browser entry via guide redirect demonstrated. FontFaceSet::load() UAF heap leak confirmed on 14.10: 192B ArrayBuffer reclaims freed CSSFontFace, engine writes two live heap pointers (+0x58/+0x68) readable by script (p563/p564). Cross-page bridge (localStorage) and Canvas same-type alias confirmed. All three upstream FontFace UAF fixes (312202, 313577, 322233) committed 2026, absent from WebKit 605.1.15. Upstream achieved RIP control on 14.00 (V59) via fontLoaded vtable dispatch through WeakPtrImpl chain. V88 self-referential forge layout fully designed (single 192B lane). 100% reclaim recipe confirmed on 14.10 (abxanax). 10 physics laws established. Lane_VA is the only remaining blocker. Gigacage OFF, IsoHeap OFF on x86_64.

milestones.title: Exploit infrastructure
milestones.note: thr_new(455) and thr_create(430) both confirmed working. Thread budget measured (25/11/9 per loader). Child threads execute kernel syscalls via fn_addr ROP chains (274c). native.fcall_with_rax confirmed (getpid/socket/close). UMTX parking pattern for thread synchronization. AIO 669 independently verified by second researcher with dmem0 destination. sceKernelAllocateDirectMemory reachable from game sandbox via libkernel GOT wrapper (DEM9N101). 13.60 offline handler decode (22 functions decompiled). SDK v0.45 published 14.10 kernel offsets (allproc, security_flags, rootvnode).

milestones.title: Validated 14.10 kernel vulnerability
milestones.note: FontFaceSet::load() UAF is a validated vulnerability on 14.10: heap pointer leak confirmed (p563/p564, 192B reclaim, +0x58/+0x68 readable), cross-firmware exploitability confirmed on 14.00 and 14.10 (issue #155). All three upstream fixes absent from WebKit 605.1.15. RIP control achieved on 14.00 (V59) via fontLoaded vtable dispatch — validates the exploitation path through WebProcess. V88 self-referential forge designed, 100% reclaim working on 14.10. UMTX orphaned waiter touches real kernel wait queue state (274e/274f). AIO double-free closed (70e: double-STATUS not double-free). Neither yet yields controlled kernel corruption on 14.10, hence 6 not 10.
